content.short: Aavegotchi is a play-to-earn RPG collectible NFT game with gamified DeFi functionality.
content.description: Aavegotchi is a blockchain game where players explore the Gotchiverse and collect Aavegotchi NFTs. The game blends decentralized finance elements such as staking and lending cryptocurrencies with play-to-earn mechanics. It features NFT raffles, bid-to-earn auctions, and a decentralized marketplace that lets players trade assets and participate in the ecosystem. Each NFT avatar can be customized with wearables to boost its rarity and potential yield, adding strategic depth to collection and gameplay.
